messages:
Kevin H: Quick heads-up — AuraGuard is ready for the secrets sync demo next Tues. They want to validate SSO + SCIM + KMS flow on a Redwood Private VPC before marketplace listing. Can we run a dry-run rehearsal this week?
Alyssa M: SG. Need to confirm test account + temporary certs from AuraGuard. @Marco can you own the env prep? :pray:
Marco L: I can. Which region and instance size do we want for the rehearsal? I suggest eu-west-1 dedicated small pool to match their infra.
Kevin H: eu-west-1 is fine. We need KMS key access pattern documented — AuraGuard wants to see envelope encryption + HSM sign/verify via their connector.
Priya S: FYI legal asked for an embargo window for the joint announcement — 7 days between go-live and public press. Also need a brief demo script for partner marketing.
Alyssa M: Noted. I'll draft demo bullets. Also, AuraGuard requested SCIM group sync sample and SCIM delta handling test.
Marco L: Creating a mini testplan:
- Provision test customer on Redwood Private in eu-west-1
- Upload partner SCIM config + provisioning token
- Run SCIM full sync -> verify users/groups
- Configure KMS key alias and simulate rotate
- Run secrets pull from VaultBridge adapter -> validate access logs
Tina R: I'll run the SCIM delta tests and check for idempotency. Can someone paste the sample SCIM payload? I want to script it.
Kevin H: paste from AuraGuard:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users
{ "userName": "jess@example.com", "name": {"givenName":"Jess","familyName":"Lo"}, "active":true }
```
Marco L: SCIM token for rehearsal (temp): RA-xmPL12345 (will rotate after test). Use it only in the rehearsal VPC.
Priya S: Heads-up: mark logs for e-discovery — security needs audit events persisted for 90 days for enterprise pilot customers.
Alyssa M: Marketing wants a 10-min clip of: SSO sign-on (SAML), SCIM provision, and 30s of secrets access with key rotate. Keep it scripted.
Kevin H: On SAML, AuraGuard uses IdP-initiated flow. Marco, can you enable IdP metadata import and do a smoke SSO test by Friday?
Marco L: Yep. I'll import metadata and post screenshots here.
Tina R: For KMS/HSM: what cert rotation cadence do we simulate? AuraGuard asked for both scheduled rotation and forced rotation.
Priya S: Simulate 30-day scheduled + immediate forced rotation to validate reactive behavior for the runbook.
Alyssa M: Also add failure-mode test: revoke KMS key in partner sandbox and ensure Redwood falls back to read-only secrets with clear observability traces.
Kevin H: Good call. We need fallback policy in the runbook. @ops-bot can you create the rehearsal incident channel and set alerts for: SCIM failures, KMS permission denied, high latency >300ms?
ops-bot: Created channel #rehearsal-auraguard-2819876543 and set alerts. Added people: Marco L, Tina R, Alyssa M, Kevin H, Priya S.
Marco L: Scheduled rehearsal slot: Fri 09:00 UTC. Can everyone make it? If not, propose alternative.
Alyssa M: I can. Priya?
Priya S: I’m good at 09:00 UTC.
Tina R: Works for me.
Kevin H: Works. Final checklist to post before Friday:
- Env URL + creds
- SCIM token
- SAML metadata
- KMS key alias + rotation script
- Demo script and recording owner
Marco L: I'll drop the env details and an infra command snippet here before EOD:
```
# create rehearsal env
redwood infra create --env auraguard-rehearsal --region eu-west-1 --type private --size small
```
Alyssa M: I'll prepare demo script and sample marketing intro.
Kevin H: Thanks all — once rehearsal passes we lock embargo window and draft joint announcement timeline. :rocket:
